character: Original Les Arcs village, designed by Charlotte Perriand (1968). Lowest of the 4 Arcs. 7-min funicular to Bourg-St-Maurice. Pedestrian-only, wooded, family-friendly. Le Cairn (pizza), Le Sanglier Qui Fume (piste-side), L'Arpette (iconic apres above village). Best for quiet family base, train arrivals.
dining: Le Cairn (pizza). Le Sanglier Qui Fume (piste-side, terrace, fire). Le Panoramic (Mont Blanc view). Snowdwich (best chips). L'Arpette (above village, DJ apres).
shopping: Grocery, bakery, rental shops, sports retail. Friendly village atmosphere.
apres_scene: L'Arpette Bar (DJ afternoon apres above village). Abreuvoir pub (happy hour, live music). Quiet village evenings. King Mad (popular bar).
activities_nearby: 7-min funicular to Bourg-St-Maurice (TGV station, shops, Tuesday market). Direct piste access. Ski school (ESF) at snow front. Igloo village above Arc 2000.
